title: INDoS WG3 Training School 2026: functional MRI preprocessing and quality control materials
description:
Teaching materials on functional MRI preprocessing with fMRIPrep, execution forensics and quality control, prepared for the Training School of Working Group 3 of the INDoS COST Action (CA24161), Madrid, 30 September to 2 October 2026: a remark.js slide deck, a browser-based quality-control rating app, and Jupyter notebooks for the practicals.

The slides and the quality-control app are served at www.indos-costaction.eu/wg3-ts2026-waller.

This repository is a DataLad dataset. Images, videos and the figures of the quality-control app are git-annex content, and the slide engine (remark-engine) is a git submodule; neither is part of this archive. Retrieve them with datalad clone https://github.com/indos-costaction/wg3-ts2026-waller, then datalad get assets fmri-visualization practical-2-quality-control and git submodule update --init lib/remark.
